title: Carrabelle History Museum

services.name: Holiday Exhibit
services.desc: The Carrabelle History Museum is pleased to announce a special holiday exhibit, “Home for the Holidays” featuring the folk art paintings of historic Carrabelle by beloved local historian, James W. “Buz” Putnal. These paintings reflect Buz’s love for Carrabelle’s heritage, capturing iconic scenes and memories that will resonate with locals and visitors alike. This nostalgic special exhibit offers visitors a unique opportunity to experience Carrabelle’s past through Buz's artwork. The exhibit opens Wednesday, December 4 and will run through Sunday, January 12, 2025, at the Carrabelle History Museum. blurb: Tamara Allen built us an amazing historical museum where Carrabelle's fascinating stories are told and our local heritage is preserved. She was so dedicated to this mission that she managed the museum for over 20 years without receiving any pay. Filling her shoes will be no small task. The greatest honor we can give her is to keep the Carrabelle History Museum operating.
